blocks.text: Managing your loan pipeline in Chrome

Your pipeline is your lifeblood. You likely have multiple tabs open for your CRM, your loan origination system, and your email. Switching between these takes time. You can use Chrome profiles to keep your work life separated from your personal browsing. Go to your profile icon in the top right of Chrome and select Add. This keeps your bookmarks and history clean for work tasks.

When you need to find a specific document or a borrower's contact info, do not click through menus. Hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask Lazur where your document portal is. Lazur will point at the tab or the link on your screen. This keeps your eyes on the content rather than the interface.
Practical Chrome tips for loan officers

items: Use ⌘ + T to open a new tab instantly when you need to search for a rate or a guideline.
Use ⌘ + L to jump to the address bar so you can type a URL or search term without reaching for your mouse.
Pin your most used sites like your CRM or email by right-clicking the tab and selecting Pin. This keeps them small and always available on the left side of your tab bar.
Use ⌘ + ⇧ + T to reopen a tab you accidentally closed. This happens often when you have twenty tabs open during a busy morning.
Clear your site data for specific sites if a portal stops loading correctly. Go to Settings > Privacy and security > Site settings > View permissions and data stored across sites.

blocks.text: Top loan officers spend only 5 hours a week on admin tasks. They do this by using shortcuts and reducing the time spent on repetitive actions. If you find yourself typing the same email responses, use snippets. With Lazur, you can dictate these responses directly into your email client. Hold fn and speak your message. Lazur formats it and puts it at your cursor.

If you are using a web-based loan origination system, make sure you have your browser's password manager enabled. It saves you from typing credentials every time you switch between systems or log back in after a timeout.
blocks.title: Secure your logins

blocks.text: Compliance requires you to keep clear records. When you review documents, you often need to check for specific data points. Do not waste time scrolling through long PDFs. Use ⌘ + F to search for keywords like signature or date within your browser's PDF viewer. If you need to export a page as a PDF, use ⌘ + P and choose Save as PDF as your destination.

Every time you look away from your screen to find a setting, you lose focus. It takes about 23 minutes to fully refocus after a distraction. By using voice commands to manage your browser, you stay in the flow. Ask Lazur to open your calendar or check your reminders while you are still looking at a loan application.

faq.question: Does Lazur click buttons for me?
faq.answer: No. Lazur points at buttons or guides you through a process, but it does not click or interact with your software for you.

faq.question: Can I use Lazur on Windows?
faq.answer: Lazur is currently built for macOS. A Windows version is planned but not available yet.

faq.question: Is my loan data safe when I use Lazur?
faq.answer: Yes. Lazur only sees your screen and listens to you while you hold the shortcut. Your data is not used to train AI models.

faq.question: Why is Chrome recommended over other browsers?
faq.answer: Chrome has the largest market share and the most robust support for web-based loan origination systems, ensuring better compatibility.
